checked.note: verified in a running system - collective check on a BTP ABAP environment (ABAP Cloud), recorded on the maintainer's statement; no per-port note

deviations.what: sap.m.SegmentedButton.contentMode is @since 1.142.0 and both SegmentedButtons of the sample are built around it (ContentFit vs EqualSized) - the property is kept 1:1, so the port needs a UI5 runtime >= 1.142; on an older release both buttons render in the pre-1.142 default width behaviour.
